name: Caesar Salad
directions: To make the croutons: Cut bread into 1-inch cubes. Arrange on a baking sheet and bake at 375°F for about 15 minutes or until golden. Remove and let cool. To make the dressing: Place all dressing ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend over low speed or pulse until smooth. In a large bowl, add chopped romaine lettuce and drizzle in a few tablespoons of Caesar dressing. Toss to coat lettuce. Sprinkle top with croutons, shaved parmesan, and cracked black pepper. Drizzle top with more dressing and enjoy!
